title: firecrawl/firecrawl
lede: Firecrawl is an open-source TypeScript service that gives agents web data through one API: search, scraping, page interaction and crawling, plus a hosted catalogue of 550+ data providers.

points: Core endpoints search the web, turn any URL into markdown, HTML, JSON or screenshots, and let an agent click and type on a scraped page.
Further endpoints crawl a site, map its URLs, batch-scrape thousands of pages, parse PDFs and DOCX, and watch pages for changes.
An Agent endpoint gathers data from a prompt alone, with no URLs needed, and accepts a schema for structured output.
Alexandria, the 550+ provider library, runs only on Firecrawl Cloud; the self-hosted server leaves it out.
SDKs cover Python, Node.js and Go, alongside a CLI, an agent skill and an MCP server.
